ABOUT THE SOLUTION

Rainbow ImmuniCare AI

A focused academic prototype for AI-assisted Vaccination Follow-up.

AI role

AI assist
Case summaries, operational prioritisation, response routing and communication drafts.
AI + Human
Recommendations are verified by employees before action.
Human / Clinical only
Diagnosis, medical advice, vaccine eligibility, schedule changes and clinical decisions.

Why this design

The solution transforms repetitive follow-up administration into a focused work queue while preserving accountability. All displayed records are synthetic and the prototype is not a clinical system.
